comment:
* Base class for the requests serviced by the remote service. * *

NOTE: this class is not used directly, you should either override * {@link com.android.internal.infra.AbstractRemoteService.PendingRequest} for sync requests, or * use {@link AbstractRemoteService#scheduleAsyncRequest(AsyncRequest)} for async requests. * * @param the remote service class * @param the interface of the binder service

methods.name: protected final S getService()
methods.comment: * Gets a reference to the remote service.

methods.name: protected final boolean finish()
methods.comment:
* Subclasses must call this method when the remote service finishes, i.e., when the service
         * finishes processing a request.
         *
         * @return {@code false} in the service is already finished, {@code true} otherwise.

methods.name: protected void onFailed()
methods.comment:
* Called when request fails due to reasons internal to {@link AbstractRemoteService},
         * e.g. failure to bind to service.

methods.name: protected final boolean isCancelledLocked()
methods.comment: * Checks whether this request was cancelled.

methods.name: public boolean cancel()
methods.comment:
* Cancels the service.
         *
         * @return {@code false} if service is already canceled, {@code true} otherwise.

methods.name: protected boolean isFinal()
methods.comment: * Checks whether this request leads to a final state where no other requests can be made.
